restaurantName: Wizard Afternoon Tea at Georgian House Hotel
bio: Venture down into the basement of Georgian House Hotel, to enjoy a spellbinding Wizard Afternoon Tea experience, filled with mystery and magic.  The Wizards at Georgian House Hotel are always casting some new culinary magic and this time they have concocted the ultimate Wizard feast!  Spellbindingly delicious and complete with all of the goodies a wizard could wish for. Their Wizards have conjured up three-courses of sweet and savoury delights, a tasty selection of secret desserts and of course some takeaway treats. Accompany this experience with a wizard potion or curious colour changing gin for the ultimate wizard feast.  The 3-course Afternoon Tea menu includes a variety of options, and a menu suitable for vegan wizards is also available.  Please Note: Some elements of the menus are subject to change.  Due to demand, Afternoon Tea is now avaliable on the following Fridays:  25th October 1st November 20th December 27th December
